choose.when:
<set-variable name="prompt" value="@{
            var m = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["messages"] as JArray;
            var u = m?.LastOrDefault(x => (string)x["role"] == "user");
            var c = u?["content"];
            if (c == null) { return ""; }
            if (c.Type == JTokenType.String) { return (string)c; }
            return string.Join("\n", c.Where(p => (string)p["type"] == "text").Select(p => (string)p["text"]));
        }" />
        
          {{router-url}}/api/router/route
          POST
          application/json
          {{jev-key}}
          @{
              var p = (string)context.Variables["prompt"];
              if (p.Length > 8000) { p = p.Substring(0, 8000); }
              return new JObject(new JProperty("prompts", new JArray(p))).ToString();
          }
        
        
        <set-variable name="decision" value="@{
            var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("r");
            if (r == null) { return "strong|fallback-timeout|"; }
            if (r.StatusCode != 200) { return "strong|fallback-http-" + r.StatusCode + "|"; }
            try {
              var x = r.Body.As()["results"][0];
              var conf = (double)x["confidence"]; var cs = conf.ToString("0.000");
              if (conf < {{router-min-confidence}}) { return "strong|fallback-low-confidence|" + cs; }
              var ch = (string)x["choice"];
              if (ch != "small" && ch != "strong" && ch != "code") { return "strong|fallback-bad-choice|" + cs; }
              return ch + "|router|" + cs;
            } catch { return "strong|fallback-parse|"; }
        }" />
